From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From re- +‎ parler.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ʁə.paʁ.le/
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)

Verb

[edit]

reparler

  1. (intransitive) to talk again, to speak again [with de ‘about something’]
    reparler de quelque chose avec quelqu'un ― to speak to someone about something again
